llms.body:
# Givebutter: Fundraising Software For Nonprofits

-[Givebutter](https://givebutter.com): An easy to use, all-in-one fundraising platform designed to streamline fundraising, marketing, and donor management for nonprofits. Below is a structured summary of the available resources and features.

## Fundraising Solutions
- [Donor management & nonprofit CRM](https://givebutter.com/donor-management-crm): Build better relationships with donors with Givebutter's free nonprofit donor management software. Create donor profiles, track history, and see supporter activity all in one place.
- [Nonprofit marketing & donor engagementengagement](https://givebutter.com/nonprofit-marketing): Givebutter makes donor engagement easy and fun with free marketing tools for nonprofits. Send branded emails, direct mail, text messages, and more, all from one dashboard.
- [Fundraising pages](https://givebutter.com/fundraising-pages): Collect donations and gain new supporters with free Givebutter fundraising pages that are engaging and optimized for your success.
- [Embeddable donation forms & donate buttons](https://givebutter.com/donation-forms): Streamline your fundraising with Givebutter's free donation forms for nonprofits. With our secure platform and powerful tools, you can raise more for your cause. 
- [Fundraising events](https://givebutter.com/fundraising-events): Elevate your event fundraising with powerful tools for virtual, in-person, and hybrid fundraising events. Streamline planning, ticket sales, event check-in, table seating, and more for your nonprofit events - all for free.
- [Free auction software for nonprofits](https://givebutter.com/auctions): Givebutter's online auction platform is free and the #1-rated silent auction software. All the auction & mobile bidding tools you need to host engaging in-person or online charity auctions.
- [Widgets](https://givebutter.com/widgets): Transform your website and create a seamless donor experience with user-friendly fundraising widgets, donate buttons, signup forms, and more easily embedded giving tools.
- [Nonprofit payment processing](https://givebutter.com/nonprofit-payment-processing): Discover a better approach to nonprofit donation processing. Accept more payment methods, easier payment reconciliation, and automatic payouts.
- [Mobile fundraising app](https://givebutter.com/mobile-app): Enjoy powerful mobile fundraising wherever you go with Givebutter's free mobile donation app. Accept donations, check in event attendees, and track fundraiser progress.
- [Wallet](https://givebutter.com/wallet): Turn donations into mission-driving rewards. Earn 2.5% APY rewards on the funds you raise, send payments, and transfer funds from one seamless financial home base.
- [Integrations](https://givebutter.com/integrations): Connect Givebutter with 1,000+ third-party applications via Zapier, use any of our native integrations such as Bloomerang, or build your own with our public API.
- [Givebutter Plus](https://givebutter.com/plus): Add Givebutter Plus to your account for game-changing workflow automations, deeper donor insights, and eye-popping supporter engagement features to help your nonprofit go from surviving to thriving. Includes advanced email editor, nonprofit texting tools, and discounted direct mail campaigns. 

## Donor Management and nonprofit CRM features
- [Donor segments](https://givebutter.com/features/donor-segments): Use donor segmentation software to easily view, sort, save and export supporter data. Givebutter helps you do all this and more - for free.
- [Importing & migration](https://givebutter.com/features/importing-and-migration): Discover how easy it is to import and migrate contacts, transactions, and recurring giving plans to Givebutter's nonprofit CRM and all-in-one fundraising platform.
- [Donation Tracking Software](https://givebutter.com/features/donation-management): Track every donation and ticket purchase, add offline payments, import transactions, and acknowledge gifts on one user-friendly platform
- [Magic Migration](https://givebutter.com/features/magic-migration): Givebutter offers smooth and secure CRM data migration and self-service imports so you can start raising more for your cause right away.
- [Membership management software](https://givebutter.com/features/membership-management): Manage membership dues, track supporters, and keep members engaged with Givebutter’s membership management software.

## Nonprofit marketing and donor engagement features
- [Campaign updates](https://givebutter.com/features/campaign-updates): Keep donors invested in your progress with free campaign updates, automated milestones, and custom graphics posted right on your fundraising page.
- [Scan-to-donate](https://givebutter.com/features/scan-to-donate): Make mobile giving as easy as snapping a picture with automatically generated QR codes that bring supporters to your donation form in seconds.
- [Text-to-donate](https://givebutter.com/features/text-to-donate): Harness with power of text giving by enabling supporters to donate by text with Givebutter's free Text-to-Donate tools.
- [Email marketing software for nonprofits](https://givebutter.com/features/email): Engage supporters like never before with custom, personalized emails complete with your branding, built-in Canva design tools, and domain linking - all for free.
- [Nonprofit direct mailing](https://givebutter.com/features/mailings): Upgrade your snail mail and turn it into scale mail with custom, donation-driving nonprofit direct mail campaigns you can print, post, and send right from your dashboard.
- [Donation receipts](https://givebutter.com/features/donation-receipts): With Givebutter, nonprofits can save time by automatically sending a custom, branded tax donation receipt for every donation or ticket purchase - all for free.
- [Meta Fundraising Integration](https://givebutter.com/integrations/meta): Automatically add donate buttons and progress bars to every Givebutter campaign shared on Facebook and Instagram. 

## Fundraising pages features
- [Supporter feed](https://givebutter.com/features/supporter-feed): Givebutter's supporter feed makes every donation feel like a celebration. Share campaign updates, public donor messages, and more directly on your fundraising page.
- [Peer-to-peer fundraising](https://givebutter.com/features/peer-to-peer-fundraising): Givebutter has everything you need to launch successful peer-to-peer fundraising campaigns, including customizable pages, trackable links, leaderboards, and more.
- [Team fundraising](https://givebutter.com/features/team-fundraising): Start a team fundraiser today to foster friendly competition and tap into your supporters' networks with unlimited teams, personalized pages, and leaderboards.

## Donation forms features
- [Matching donations](https://givebutter.com/features/matching-gifts): Givebutter's free donation match software offers nonprofits a convenient way to promote and automate matching donations on any fundraising campaign or event.
- [Giving hub](https://givebutter.com/features/giving-hub): Showcase your mission and all your campaigns with Givebutter's free nonprofit website builder. Learn how to create a fundraiser website with ease - no coding needed.

## Fundraising events features
- [Livestreaming](https://givebutter.com/features/livestreaming): Discover how to livestream a nonprofit event and raise more for your cause with Givebutter's free livestream fundraising tools.
- [Live display](https://givebutter.com/features/live-display): Showcase live donations on any projector screen, TV, or tablet at in-person fundraising events. Includes real-time giving display, text-to-donate, and more!
- [Nonprofit event ticket sales & event registration](https://givebutter.com/features/event-ticketing): Transform your fundraising events with free nonprofit ticketing software. Streamline registration, sell tickets online, and turn attendees into lasting supporters.
- [Registration fundraising](https://givebutter.com/features/registration-fundraising): Make it easy for event participants to register, join a team, and fundraise—all in one flow— with Givebutter’s free online event registration software.
- [Online raffle platform](https://givebutter.com/features/raffles): Run free online raffles with Givebutter. Create digital raffle tickets, launch a custom raffle page, track entries, and easily export to pick winners—all in one platform.

## Nonprofit auction features
- [Auction management](https://givebutter.com/features/auction-management): Manage bidders, track bids, export winners, oversee item fulfillment, and more with Givebutter's online auction management system - all in one place, and all for free.
- [Mobile bidding](https://givebutter.com/features/mobile-bidding): Givebutter makes silent auction mobile bidding a breeze. Bidders can place bids, get notifications, and check out from any device - no mobile bidding app required.

## Nonprofit payment processing features
- [Accept PayPal donations](https://givebutter.com/features/paypal-donations): Instantly accept PayPal donations for free through Givebutter - no complicated setup, donation fees, or PayPal account required.
- [Offline donations](https://givebutter.com/features/offline-donations): Track your cash and check donations in the same place as your online transactions. Enjoy better offline donation management with an all-in-one fundraising platform.
- [Accept Venmo donations](https://givebutter.com/features/venmo-donations): Learn how to set up Venmo for donations and add a Venmo donate button to your nonprofit website for free with Givebutter.
- [Recurring donations](https://givebutter.com/features/recurring-donations): Accept recurring donations online through forms, fundraising pages, or your website to build sustainable revenue for your cause. Accept yearly, quarterly, and monthly donations.
- [Accept Apple Pay donations & Google Pay donations](https://givebutter.com/features/apple-pay-google-pay-donations): Enjoy the benefits of Apple Pay for nonprofits and Google Pay for nonprofits without the hassle of managing multiple accounts. Plus, donors cover processing fees!
- [Accept DAF donations](https://givebutter.com/features/daf-donations): Offer a DAF payment option on your donation forms, add a DAF widget to your website, connect directly with DAF donors, and more - all for free on Givebutter.
- [Tap to Pay](https://givebutter.com/features/tap-to-pay): Turn good intentions into donations with Givebutter’s tap to donate machine. Accept credit/debit cards and digital wallets via contactless donation terminals.
- [ACH donations](https://givebutter.com/features/ach-donations): Enjoy lower transaction fees with secure ACH payment processing for nonprofits offered on all fundraising pages, donation forms, and events.
- [Pledge donations](https://givebutter.com/features/pledges): No more missed donations. Log, track, and collect 100% of pledged donations while fostering stronger donor relationships with free pledge management software.
- [Cash App donations](https://givebutter.com/features/cash-app): Boost conversion rates and give mobile-first donors a smoother way to give with free Cash App donations on Givebutter—easy setup, minimal transaction fees.

## Donation widgets Features
- [Donate buttons](https://givebutter.com/features/donate-buttons): Givebutter's free donate buttons and forms make it easy to drive online donations. Learn how to add a custom donation widget to your site in just a few clicks. Works with popular website domains such as Squarespace, WordPress, Wix, Weebly, GoDaddy, and more.
- [Signup forms](https://givebutter.com/features/signup-forms): The free email collector you've been looking for - seamlessly integrated with a full spread of modern, user-friendly fundraising, CRM, and engagement tools.
- [Fundraising thermometer](https://givebutter.com/features/fundraising-thermometer): Boost engagement with Givebutter's customizable live fundraising thermometer generator. Display real-time progress and reach your campaign goal faster!

## Givebutter Plus Features
- [Texting software for nonprofits](https://givebutter.com/plus/texting): Send custom, personalized texts to any segment of your contacts and seamlessly track your ROI with Givebutter's mass texting service for nonprofits.
- [Task management for nonprofits](https://givebutter.com/plus/task-management): Looking for a nonprofit task manager to help you accomplish more with less stress? We've got just what you need, on the platform you already love.
- [Workflows](https://givebutter.com/plus/workflows): Learn about time-saving nonprofit automation tools that take care of repetitive tasks, personalize communications at scale, and improve donor engagement.
- [QuickBooks Online](https://givebutter.com/plus/quickbooks): Givebutter’s native QuickBooks Online integration for nonprofits automatically syncs donations and keeps your books clean—now available with Givebutter Plus.

## Additional Features
-[Features](https://givebutter.com/features): Fundraise better, faster, and for free with more than 160 features designed for raising funds, tracking progress, and engaging your supporters like never before.

## Community and Support
- [Help center](https://help.givebutter.com/en/): Find answers to common questions and access support resources.
- [Success stories](https://givebutter.com/success-stories): Read about successful fundraising campaigns and learn from others' experiences.
- [Givebutter Experts](https://givebutter.com/experts): Connect with experts for personalized assistance and guidance.

## Company Information
- [About Givebutter](https://givebutter.com/about): Learn more about the mission and vision of Givebutter.
- [Changelog](https://community.givebutter.com/changelog): Stay updated on the latest features and improvements.
- [Product roadmap](https://community.givebutter.com/): View upcoming features and enhancements planned for the platform.
- [Pricing](https://givebutter.com/pricing): Explore pricing options and find a plan that fits your nonprofit's needs.


## User Reviews and Comparisons
- [Compare Givebutter](https://givebutter.com/compare): See how Givebutter stacks up against other fundraising platforms.
- [Reviews](https://givebutter.com/reviews): Read user reviews to understand the experiences of other nonprofits using Givebutter.

## Additional Resources
- [Nonprofit Blog](https://givebutter.com/blog): Access articles and insights on fundraising trends and best practices.
- [Fundraising ideas](https://givebutter.com/fundraising-ideas): Discover creative ideas to inspire your next fundraising campaign.
- [Freebies for nonprofits](https://givebutter.com/freebies): Get access to free resources, tools, generators, and templates to aid your fundraising efforts.
- [Nonprofit Webinars](https://givebutter.com/events): Participate in free nonprofit webinars that offer continuing education credits for fundraising professionals.

## Legal and Safety Information
- [Terms of Use](https://givebutter.com/terms): Review the terms governing the use of Givebutter's services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://givebutter.com/privacy): Understand how your data is handled and protected.
- [Accessibility](https://givebutter.com/accessibility): Learn about Givebutter's commitment to accessibility for all users.
- [Trust & safety](https://givebutter.com/trust-and-safety): Read about the measures in place to ensure a safe fundraising environment.

## Contact and Support
- [Contact us](https://givebutter.com/contact): Reach out for support or inquiries regarding Givebutter's services.
- [Education Hub](https://givebutter.com/education-hub): Top product education resources for how to use the Givebutter platform, including on-demand courses, live training, and short videos packed with best practices.

This structured summary provides a comprehensive overview of the features and resources available through Givebutter, making it easier for nonprofits to navigate their fundraising needs.
